messages:
ashley: Hey team — quick heads up, PR #12890 is sitting blocked by CI. Only failing on linux-shard-2 e2e, looks like a flaky external call. Can someone take a quick look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/pkgs/pull/12890 :eyes:

ci-bot: CI summary for PR #12890 — one job failed out of 12
- linux-shard-2: FAIL test_e2e_payment_flow.py::test_third_party_timeout (timeout)
- rerun suggested: targeted job retry (no snapshot change)

brad: I can grab it in ~10m. Any repro logs attached?

ashley: Pasting the failing snippet:```
requests.exceptions.ReadTimeout: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='payments.external', port=443): Read timed out.
E   AssertionError: payment status != SUCCESS
```

kevin: That external service has been flaky this week. If it's a timeout, we shouldn't update snapshots. We should either retry the job or mock the call in the test.

maya: Agree with Kevin. We had an incident on that dependency yesterday. Rerun usually clears it. Want me to kick a targeted rerun? :thumbsup:

ashley: Yes please — if it passes I'll ask for approvals and merge. If it flakes again I'll open a small test patch to mock it.

sam: FYI I can approve once it's green. Please @sam when rerun completes.

ci-bot: Triggered manual rerun for linux-shard-2 (targeted). Job id: 987654.

dylan: Heads up the rerun queue is a bit backed up this morning; may take ~5-8m. If it fails twice in a row we should avoid blocking release and consider skipping the test with a ticket.

ashley: Noted. I'll hold the merge until either a successful rerun or we agree on skipping. Thanks for the quick coordination.

ci-bot: Rerun result: linux-shard-2 -> SUCCESS. All checks passing.

sam: Green — approving now. :white_check_mark:

brad: Thanks everyone. Ashley — go ahead to merge when the final required approvals are recorded.

ashley: Merged and will monitor post-merge smoke. Filing a follow-up ticket to add a tighter mock for the external call so this doesn't flake again. Ticket: INT-4523.
